title: Scalar extension of an arbitrary integral Chern arrow
statement: For Chern data c [def-sp-tower-class-chern] and any integral arrow f from the unit of Rrings in degree zero to c.rootModule shifted by two, scalarChernArrow is the actual composite of c.scalarUnit.inv, c.scalar.T.map f, the canonical scalar shift comparison, and lineComparison shifted by two. Its explicit source is unit T (Arings l E T) and its explicit target is line l E c shifted by two. This copies the existing firstChern construction with its integral argument left arbitrary; it is fully constructed, with no chosen data or hole.

def scalarChernArrow (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E]
    {T : Scheme.{u}} (c : Chern l E T)
    (f : unit T (Rrings l T) ⟶
      ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (Systems T (Rrings l T)) 0).obj
        c.rootModule)⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧) :
    unit T (Arings l E T) ⟶ (line l E c)⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧
